title: A Letter from a Stranger
subtitle: The start of a tragedy, or maybe the beginning of an adventure.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, now that we have given the reports,

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: and Madam Z said we won't have any other assignments for a while ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It may be a little abrupt to ask, but I was wondering if you would like to take a heritage train ride with me.
On the other side of the corridor full of Foundation staff, someone is also hitting one dead end after another.
Please, trust me. This journey will be the best ever. Let's start off immediately and come back furtively, so nobody will know.

items.speaker: Male Investigator
items.text: No, thank you. I'm not interested.
Okay, fine. Oh, wait, Angie, do you wanna travel? Let's start off immediately and come back furtively, so nobody will know!

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: I'm flattered that you asked. But I'm leaving for an assignment soon, so I'm not gonna make it.
Really? That's a sad coincidence. I heard that you've worked so hard and have saved up so many unused leaves. You also have two days of outing permission.
The young man turns around, suddenly raises his arm, and comes this way.
Oh. Hey, guys!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Us?
Yes, you guys.
Our great Ms. Timekeeper and her excellent assistant, Sonetto. Am I right?
Yes, that's us.

branch.text: Accepting the title "great" without hesitation, you are really the Vertin we've heard about.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Heard about?
We all know the trouble you stirred up. I was several grades above you. Though the instructors prohibited any discussions of that incident, they couldn't stop people from being curious.
But soon no one asked about that any more, because it was just the wrong thing to do. And there was no vacancy in the guardhouse.
Anyways, I remember you.

items.text: Who? I've never heard of these names.

branch.text: Hmmm ... then there might be two explanations.
One, I got the wrong person. Two, this is your sense of humor.
Such a puzzle. Deducting by the logic, we might be drowning in the latter one—you just made a joke.
I don't find it funny, but considering I have an odd sense of humor, I can politely laugh at your joke.
Like this ... ha ha ha ha ha!

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Hmm ... this is super awkward.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't worry, Timekeeper. Although his manner is debatable, he is not a bad person.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: He was the one who received the Outstanding Contribution Award in the latest annual appraisal. Allow me to introduce ...
No, wait. Don't use that name!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Here, with Timekeeper, just call me Horropedia, which I prefer.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Okay, Mr. Ho- ... Horropedia. I've never heard of this nickname of yours.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: It's a long story. I can share with you at another time. Now, let's get down to business.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Have you guys heard of the myth of the Green Lake Campsite?
I'm not a fan of urban legends.

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: Oh? I get it.

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: I thought you will be really interested in it, since you've done a great job.

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: What job? Hah. Do you mean ...?
Sonetto breaks off. They did receive a letter not long ago.
It was an unusual letter, stating a strange requirement about researching for an old map ...

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: Helping me find the map. What do you think I'm talking about?

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: It was well done. See, here are six maps. The most intact and beautiful one was from you!

items.text: So it was you who sent me the letter.

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: Yeah, it was me. Given that you didn't know me, I sent it anonymously.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: I don't see how these are correlated.

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: Well, of course they are. An anonymous envelope better triggers curiosity. And you are the most inquisitive person I know.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Didn't you worry that I might throw it away?

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: Honestly, I did. So I wrote to another 13 people. Now I have six maps.

branch.speaker: Horropedia
branch.text: But don't be upset. Yours is the most intact one, so I selected it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for your approval.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: A mystery solved. No wonder I found the handwriting on the envelope familiar.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I did some research on Green Lake Campsite after piecing together the map.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It was the map of one of the training bases of Zeno. They used to train their Youth Force there in the early 60s and deserted that base in the early 70s.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It had been underused even before it was abandoned. It was more of a boy scout camping site than a military training base.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Exactly, Ms. Sonetto.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: But this is the outdated version of the story now. This is not your fault. You haven't been in the headquarters for a long time, so you must have missed out on some first-hand information.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Now, about the Green Lake Campsite, we have some updates.
An enigmatic look appears on Horropedia's face. His voice drops.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: That was a night in 1971, a night with pouring rain.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: ... heavily and hastily. Sheets of rain formed a barrier, isolating the woods from the outside world. In that rain, the communication center of Zeno lost contact with the Green Lake Campsite.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Was it normal rain?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: It was. Drops of water with dust falling from above. It didn't cause any illusions or unusual symptoms but took away all the Youth Force stationed at the campsite.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: In the cabin they lived, people found clothes, blankets, even books left open on the table. What does not move or breathe stayed there as usual. But their owners, those living youngsters, disappeared from the woods like drops of dew under the sun.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Since then, nobody has ever seen those Youth Force again. Zeno has not, nor Laplace, nor us. Green Lake Campsite has then become a ghastly and deserted land.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Ms. Sonetto, please put down your hands. They are hindering your ears from receiving information. You might then miss the climax.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Thank you for the kind reminder.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: It was an unforgettable night. Three months later, all the missing members of the Youth Force came back to Zeno.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: They carried the smell of fungi and moist air, stepping into their dorm without making any noise. They claimed that they just came back from a tough mission in the rain forest.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: No one knew what the mission was. No one knew which rain forest they referred to.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The personality of all those kids have changed.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The outgoing Bruno became speechless. The gentle Anna Queenie starts picking quarrels with others ... They were not who they were, but no one could pin down the difference.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Day after day, the smell of fungi and moist soil never disappeared. It lingered for one week, two weeks, three weeks ...

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Till one night, the grade-one student Dries suddenly woke up from his dream ...

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: A muddy tentacle, stretching out beneath his bed, closed around on his ankle and pulled him onto the floor! There, a face awaited him—a hideous face of a human-like creature with a bloody mouth!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto, easy. You are going to break your wand.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I know. I, I was just a bit caught off-guard. It has never come to my mind that such a bizarre event would take place within an official institution.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Funny story, Mr. Horropedia. As an urban myth, however, the ending is way too clear and powerful. The element of drama ruins its authenticity.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're good at making stories. Next time you can be more meticulous ... Hmm?
Zeno Armaments Academy.
The best military talents training base at present.
The members of Youth Force were relatively younger, with less combat experience and capability compared to those graduates. Still, they have received years of training as reserve soldiers.
As we all know, Zeno would arm their Youth Force and the trainers with drill weapons for outings.
It was nearly impossible to wipe out the Youth Force in the territory of Zeno without being noticed by the academy.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I see. So it's not true, just a made-up story. Ms. Tooth Fairy? Did you come back from the trip?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I've rerouted my journey to a new destination. My companion suggested us to meet at the Foundation first, so I came back earlier.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Anything wrong with the original destination?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It's fine, and safe. But now I have a better place to go.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It's a place of myths and danger. There once lived many adolescents. With any luck, I will embrace a harvest of baby teeth!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No way. The place you are heading is ...

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It's Green Lake Campsite.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But, wasn't it a story? A story made up by Mr. Horropedia.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: He made up part of it, such as the bloody hand underneath the bed and the midnight screaming.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Except for those, the rest is exactly the same as I know.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But as you just said, in their own training base, it's almost impossible for the Youth Force to be …

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It proves that Green Lake Campsite is out of this world, a place worth visiting.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: You're three minutes and fifteen seconds late, Ms. Tooth Fairy.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: No worries. I didn't waste my time waiting.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: We need more people to join us. Angie and Dolf have turned me down, but Vertin and Sonetto haven't walked away yet.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I am trying to win them over. I think I'm almost there. Now they are really attracted by the Green Lake, so we are starting off soon!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Attracted?! Pardon me, Jo- ... Mr. Horropedia. We did not plan to go there, and we certainly do not feel any strong attraction to that place!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Oh? Really? But Vertin seems to be very attracted. Or am I mistaken about the look on her face?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper?
Several pairs of eyes look over.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I am kind of attracted, indeed.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: See that? I am right.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I'm glad to see you in an adventuous spirit, Ms Vertin.
It is so decided.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Great! Take your suitcase, pack your clothes, don't forget to bring two novels to kill time.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Now, let's take the hands of our two new partners. Journey on!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Pl-Please … wait a minute!
